author: Stealthbomber16
body:
It began with a demon.
No ordinary demon.
Terrorblade.
His name strikes fear in all who recognize it. Terrorblade.

Terrorblade was raised in the nether, breaking all the rules of the Demon Code, the infernal laws even demons must obey. Terrorblade learned a lesson from this: Even the nether has a nether. He was taken to a place darker than the nether: The end. The enderman are his kind, significantly weakened and transformed from spending time in their realm.

But Terrorblade mastered this realm, and learned a way out. Still containing most of his old power, and driven mad by fury. Terrorblade rose to this world. He found Imdut Valley, and gathered followers, called the Dire, and then drove them into a war against those who opposed him, called the Radiant. Locked in a struggle, the two sides fought for a century. Generation after generation continued, until Terrorblade was slain.

The Dire slinked into their caves, and slowly died off.

Or so we thought.
They are back now and aching for revenge.

The struggle continues once more, and now you are a part of it, in Ancients.


(Pretty cool, eh?)

Download here https://www.dropbox.com/sh/eydcmyydci1n8e7/AABrZw0t5Yw_nqltsatGXeY4a
That should work. If it doesn't I'm not sure what to do.
Trailer here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o1_hXyrpjv4
The map is a bit different than the trailer. I changed it a bit and added detail after studying other maps. You'll find the updated map is more detailed than that in the trailer.
YML is in the download. Of course, it is map.yml.txt. Go notepad!

Hope you enjoy my first contribution to Avicus.
